hooks.name: UX Writing Coach Routing
hooks.description: Before agent responses, route text, documentation, copy, and slide-writing requests toward the global ux-writing-coach skill.

action.prompt: If the user asks to create, review, rewrite, improve, translate, shorten, clarify, or structure text, UX copy, documentation, release notes, README content, component docs, user-facing labels, error messages, empty states, notifications, or slides, activate or suggest the global `ux-writing-coach` skill. Use it to keep language concise, accessible, design-system-aware, and aligned with the user's DesignOps preferences. Do not force it for purely technical code changes unless user-facing text or documentation is part of the task.
